text:
Sophie: Morning all — final prep for Saturday's Alley + MiniConf. Items: booth footprint swap, last-minute speaker submission, bench stat postcards, webinar follow-up funnel, and swag bags. Please ack and call out blockers.

Marco: Ack. Booth swap confirmed with venue: moving from 3C to 2A (closer to entrance). Need new floor decal print by 11am.

Elaine: Speaker update: we got one late submission from a YC startup for a 10-min lightning slot. Can we fit? I can reshuffle schedule but need sign-off.

Priya: I like the energy — slot them in if they have slides. Send slide deck to drive by 09:30. We'll do a quick 5-min tech check at 10:00.

Darren: Swag bags: final count 120. Included: postcard (bench stat), sticker sheet, promo code card, and a small phone stand. Printer confirmed 150 bags in case of walk-ups. PO# 2026-ALY.

Sophie: Bench stat wording draft: "Typical throughput: 3-5x improvement in tokens/sec with batching; 30% lower per-token cost with caching." Keep on back of postcard with QR to eval landing. Thoughts?

Marco: Shorten for space: "3-5x tokens/sec | ~30% lower per-token cost." QR -> /eval?utm=alley. Good to go.

Elaine: Lightning speaker slides uploaded at 09:18. Quick QA: one image bleed. @Priya can you crop?

Priya: Done 09:27. Slides exported to PDF and added to master deck. 10:00 tech check scheduled.

events-bot: Booth move approved. New allocation: 2A (corner), power on left table, footprint 8x6ft. Contact manager: Raul +1-555-3344.

Sophie: Lead routing plan reminder: QR postcards -> Typeform short form (name,email,company,interest) -> Zapier -> Intercom inbox "events-alley" + add tag "alley-2026" -> Airtable row. Follow-up: immediate auto-email with calendar link, SDR queue assignment within 24hrs. Amanda is OOO; Priya to own Zap test.

Priya: Running Zap test now 09:40. Test submits to Intercom and Airtable. Will post screenshot if successful.

Darren: Quick ops note: power strip shortage. Bringing two; if attendees plug phones in it's fine but keep demo devices prioritized.

Marco: Banner print had a typo on url (missing hyphen). Reprint ETA 10:50. Temporary fix: place small sticker over typo for first hour.

Sophie: Webinar follow-up: record the lightning track, stitch into 2-min highlight clip, and send to registrants next week with the bench one-pager. Who owns clip? Marco?

Marco: I can edit a 2-min highlight. Will export by Monday EOD. Need raw recording saved to drive labeled alley/recordings.

Elaine: On-site speaker swap accepted. Hosting notes: 8-min lightning + 2-min QA. Keep mics tight.

Priya: Zap test successful 09:45  Intercom shows tag 'alley-2026' and Airtable row created. Screenshot in drive.

Sophie: Great. Final asks: Marco please bring gaffer + spare pole for banner; Darren confirm bag drop at 11:30; Priya confirm Zap monitors for 24hrs; Elaine coordinate speaker intro copy. Any other blockers?

Darren: Bag drop confirmed 11:30. I'll also bring a small hand-scan device to mirror QR hits if Typeform cell is slow.

Sophie: Perfect. If nothing else, I'll post a one-paragraph social post after the event with bench stat and link to recording. Thanks team :boom:
